note: Generations added after r6. Source code stopped being the ledger here: every generation up to and including r6 is a hand-written chain in build_lifecycle(), which is why adopting one publication took five coordinated edits across two files. Entries below are data, appended by `tools/dev.py repin --approve`, and build_lifecycle() derives their candidate/approved/active/superseded records the same way it does the hand-written ones. The historical chains are deliberately NOT migrated into this file: they are committed and verified, and rewriting them to prove a new mechanism risks the one thing the ledger exists to protect.
